methodology.detection: C-SAR amplitude backscatter thresholding with pre-event multi-temporal baseline subtraction
methodology.permanent_water_treatment: Excluded pre-event permanent waterbodies (Vembanad Lake, backwaters, and river channels) with make_valid topological cleaning
methodology.area_calculation_method: Projected planar area summation in UTM Zone 43N (EPSG:32643)
limitations: Vegetation canopy and dense water hyacinth can cause radar specular scattering variations
Built-up urban structures produce double-bounce reflections that can mask surface standing water
Candidate routes strictly exclude mapped inundation segments and require field ground-truth passability verification
